displayDescription: A curtain-up night stage: the idea lamp lights and links to mirrored nodes and a ledger in strict axial symmetry.
styleRenderer: Canvas 2D (procedural illustrated stage, cached static back wall and seeded grain)
motionEngine: GSAP 3 paused timeline (window.__timelines.video) as the single owner of canvas scene state, the per-word title x transforms and the gold rule scaleX
limitations: Blender was excluded by the user; Canvas 2D stands in for 3D, and the depth is a layered 2D push-in, not a 3D camera.
Lighting, glow and floor reflections are painted 2D gradients and alpha mirrors, not physical light transport.
The grain is a static seeded texture.
The palette is a scene-dependent night stage chosen from source-frame review; the earlier cream background was an example swatch, not an approved token.
No preview recipes were supplied in STYLE.json; this refresh demonstrates the source-frame background review instead.
Didot/Bodoni 72 are referenced via @font-face local() system fonts with a Georgia/serif fallback; the title's settle is a per-word x-spread transform, not a letter-spacing change.
